description: This is a utility class `StringUtils` that provides a method for pluralizing words based on a given numerical value. It is part of a book tracking application and contains a static method to assist with string formatting.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing string-related helper methods, specifically for pluralization based on count.

methods.name: pluralize
methods.description: Returns the singular or plural form of a given string based on the provided number.
